name: Price
description: Allow to define price types, VAT categories and multiple prices for products.
project_description: Price is a core Arch submodule that gives products a rich multi-price model. It defines two config entity types — Price type (e.g. retail, wholesale) and VAT category (tax rate) — and a composite `price` field that stores net or gross amounts per price type, currency, VAT category and availability window. A price-negotiation service picks the effective price for a given customer at request time, honouring per-role price-type access and time-limited prices. Amounts are formatted through the contrib Currency module. Prices, VAT and net/gross values are always computed server-side from stored field data.
